Perfect! After Nxd6, White is up a queen (9 points of material). The move is decisive.

**Best move:** Nf5+

**Main line:** Nf5+ Kh8 (or Kg8) Nxd6 and White wins Black's queen, gaining decisive material advantage.

**Motif:** Fork (the knight forks king and queen)

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's queen is undefended and far from home, look for forcing moves with your minor pieces—especially knight checks. Here, Nf5+ forks the king and queen in one blow. After Black moves the king out of check, you simply capture the queen. Always scan for knight jumps that hit two pieces at once, especially when one is the king!
